tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅: bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba rgyas par 'dod na/ ling ro dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mthing nag gru gsum gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag: rak+sha thod phreng dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgan gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang : glo bur rtsub pa'i skeg rigs kun: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bzlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la bsgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdan steng nas: hūm̐ chen ka ra dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sogs/ hūm̐ bh+yo: shar phyogs dri za'i gdan steng nas: rnam par rgyal ba dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: shar lho me lha'i gdan steng nas: dbyug pa sngon po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la dbang ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgan gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang : glo bur rtsub pa'i keg rigs kun: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdan steng nas: gshin rje'i gshed po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri= hūm̐ bh+yo: lho nub srin po'i gdan steng nas: mi g.yo mgon po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs klu dbang gdan steng nas: rta mgrin rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: nub byang rlung lha'i gdan steng nas:

'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdan steng nas: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgan gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang : glo bur rtsub pa'i keg rigs kun: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: byang shar dbang ldan gdan steng nas: khams gsum rnam rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: 'og phyogs sa bdag gdan steng nas: ma hā ba la dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: ye shes klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor nas: rigs kyi tshom bu dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: yang sprul khro bo khro mo dang : za gsod phra man dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: hūm̐ bh+yo: drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon 'chang ba: log tri pa las stong khams khengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐ bh+yo: dregs 'dul drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyud gsum dregs pa las la bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral ba yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgan gzhon sri: nad sri dar sri ngan pa sogs: glo bur rtsub pa'i keg rigs kun: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhing bcu tshang pa'i dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: thun la brten nas bsad pa ni/ lcags phye/ zangs phye/ yungs kar/ yungs nag /ke tshe/ shang tshe/ zi ra nag po/ rdo phye/ phung sa/ lan tshwa/ tsha ba gsum/

thang phrom/ gzhan yang dug sna dang khrag sna rang gi dri mas mgos par byas la/ lcags hom du blugs la/ thun snod e sgrom me 'bar ba'i klong du thun rdzas nad mtshon dug gi dngos po dgra bgegs kha phung rjes med du gtong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ sngags mthar/ glo bur bar chad keg sri ngan pa thams cad trig nan e hur thum dzaḥ gzir nan kā wā tsi shag ling myog rbad rbad: zhes bsgrub te bsad las kyi dus su brdeg /dmigs gnad khyad par ni/ dmigs bya'i gnas lngar gnam lcags kyi tsakra rtsibs bzhi sra zhing 'thas pa dang*/ mchod rten nag pos mnan pas bskal pa'i bar du g.yo 'gul med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ sngags mthar/ glo bur bar chad keg sri ngan pa thams cad e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ bh+rūm̐ s+t+wām bha ya tri gnan: zhes rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla'o// //
